dispatch_sends_*.macho provenance

Source: dispatch_sends.m. It declares its own NSString / NSArray / NSObject
interfaces so it needs no Apple SDK, and it covers the cases that make receiver
resolution hard: a receiver register clobbered by an earlier send, a chained
send whose receiver is the previous send's result, a class send following an
instance send, one class reference used from two branches, [[NSObject alloc]
init], and an @implementation method dispatching through super. A 24-byte
integer struct adds class, dynamic-instance, and super returns with four
selector arguments. Clang emits the x86-64 calls through objc_msgSend_stret and
objc_msgSendSuper2_stret, while arm64 keeps objc_msgSend and objc_msgSendSuper2
and carries the indirect result address in x8.

Compiler and linker: clang 22.1.8 with ld64.lld 22.1.8 (LLVM
ca7933e47d3a3451d81e72ac174dcb5aa28b59d1). Each Mach-O records
LC_BUILD_VERSION platform macos, sdk 11.0, tool lld.

Commands (run in this directory):
  clang -target arm64-apple-macos11  -O0 -dynamiclib -fuse-ld=lld -nostdlib \
    -Wl,-undefined,dynamic_lookup dispatch_sends.m -o dispatch_sends_arm64.macho
  clang -target x86_64-apple-macos11 -O0 -dynamiclib -fuse-ld=lld -nostdlib \
    -Wl,-undefined,dynamic_lookup dispatch_sends.m -o dispatch_sends_x86_64.macho
  clang -target arm64-apple-macos11  -O2 -dynamiclib -fuse-ld=lld -nostdlib \
    -Wl,-undefined,dynamic_lookup dispatch_sends.m -o dispatch_sends_arm64_opt.macho
  clang -target x86_64-apple-macos11 -O2 -dynamiclib -fuse-ld=lld -nostdlib \
    -Wl,-undefined,dynamic_lookup dispatch_sends.m -o dispatch_sends_x86_64_opt.macho

The two committed pairs are the same source at two optimization levels because
the codegen differs in ways that matter to the resolver:

  -O0 loads every selref and classref with adrp + ldr, spills arguments to the
  stack, and calls _objc_msgSend through a __got slot.

  -O2 tail-calls _objc_msgSend, keeps the dispatch pointer in a callee-saved
  register across a call, moves values between registers before the call, and
  (on arm64) gets its adrp + ldr pairs relaxed by the linker into PC-relative
  ldr-literal loads. _branch_shared_classref loads its class reference once in
  the entry block and uses it from two successor blocks.

The predecessor pair of this fixture set carried no provenance file. Their
LC_BUILD_VERSION records tool lld 22.1.6 and their UUIDs start 4C4C44 ("LLD"),
so they were real clang plus lld output too, one patch release older.

objc_dispatch_sends.rs derives its expectations by parsing dispatch_sends.m: the
declared @interface names give the set of statically determinable receivers,
every other receiver expression is expected to resolve to no class, and the
[[C alloc] init] pair is expected to fold into a single objc_alloc_init call.
The same derived table is applied to all four binaries.
